metadata.title: Merger Criteria of Multiple Massive Black Holes and the Impact on the Host Galaxy

notes: No eligible stars: the paper provides no individual star identifiers and identifies no observed star as a Galactic unbound candidate. The “high-velocity stars” discussed at T:p10-b5 and T:p10-b6 are simulated stellar particles in model galaxies (models B0, B1, and BH2), not named Milky Way stars, and the paper applies no criterion establishing that they are unbound from the Milky Way. The MBHs, AGN, and galaxies discussed are not stars.
